metadata.title: HMIS linked knowledge registry
metadata.statement: Public-source-bounded research structure; not a complete live national HMIS dictionary.
metadata.versionPolicy: Current public forms, historical technical definitions and historical published outputs remain explicitly separated.
metadata.rmnchaLinkageRule: Objects in maternal/newborn/reproductive-health or child/adolescent/nutrition domains are discoverable in the RMNCH+A vertical without changing their HMIS identity.
metadata.immunizationLinkageRule: HMIS objects classified to Immunization or explicitly referring to immunization, vaccination, AEFI or cold chain are tagged for Programme 3 discovery without changing HMIS identity.
